svg.title: Agentroid
svg.desc: Agentroid: an MCP server and a Rust daemon that let Claude Code look at and operate an Android phone or emulator over adb, built to spend as little of the agent's context as it can. The screen comes back as a numbered UI tree (text, not screenshots), or just what changed since an earlier snapshot; job_start runs several steps on the daemon with no model round trip between them; the bridge makes no model calls and needs no API key, so it reports 0 tokens for itself. 27 MCP tools, Apache-2.0, preview release. Beside it, two real recordings cross-fade: look then four taps on the phone's Calculator (7 × 6 = 42), and one job_start call running six steps (9 × 8 + 7 = 79). Opens github.com/Sohwhat6420/agentroid-mcp.
